issue.title: Add `compiler.define` option
issue.body:
Adds a `compiler.define` option to next.config.js to statically replace any variables during build-time for Turbopack. This is similar to Webpack's `DefinePlugin`.

Relates to: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/discussions/71476

issue.title: fix(es/resolver): Ignore `VarDecl` with `declare: true`
issue.body:
**Description:**

`declare const MY_MAGIC_VARIABLE: string` is not a variable declaration.

**Related issue:**

 - https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/72576
